name: S2C fresh original CALMET same-GEO native 143h
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - automation/verify-s2c-fresh-original-calmet-20261017
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/s2c-fresh-original-calmet-20261017.yml
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  native-p6-2022:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 180
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact PR27 scientific implementation
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: 8a2d8edb9b764dade39167a73247f9e4ee278b4d
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify HEAD and install native compilers
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "8a2d8edb9b764dade39167a73247f9e4ee278b4d"
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/s2c/build" "$RUNNER_TEMP/s2c/audit"
          echo "PR27_IMPLEMENTATION_SHA=8a2d8edb9b764dade39167a73247f9e4ee278b4d" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/s2c/audit/source.txt"
          echo "P4_P5=FROZEN_TRACKED_2022_FILES_NOT_FRESHLY_REGENERATED" >> "$RUNNER_TEMP/s2c/audit/source.txt"
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends cmake g++-12 gfortran-11 libgdal-dev
          python3 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check PyYAML==6.0.3
      - name: Restore pinned SRTM original data and inspect pinned GENERIC landuse
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          root="$RUNNER_TEMP/s2c"
          curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 2 \
            --output "$root/source-srtm.tif" \
            https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RRain001/CTEAS/dfad99a78ed84d655e21411c9d25eb0d2583bf13/calpuff_terrain_and_landuse_data_crop/hefei_5km/china_srtm/srtm_60_06_hefei_5km.tif
          echo "c4211914fce527d2ad41ecac1e668d7faa2904bbbfd9135868ee83ef0d32123f  $root/source-srtm.tif" | sha256sum -c -
          gen=calpuff_terrain_and_landuse_data_crop/hefei_5km/eurasia_asia_landuse/eausgs2_0la_hefei_5km.generic.txt
          echo "bd937d99fb13b49ac6185c080359bef050afe76fc63945ac53b7d676547d43dc  $gen" | sha256sum -c -
          sha256sum "$root/source-srtm.tif" "$gen" > "$root/audit/original-input-sha256.txt"
      - name: Freshly compile native P1, P2 and P3
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          b="$RUNNER_TEMP/s2c/build"
          cmake -S native_cpp/p1 -B "$b/p1" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=g++-12
          cmake --build "$b/p1" --target cteas_p1_terrain --parallel 2
          cmake -S native_cpp -B "$b/p2" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=g++-12
          cmake --build "$b/p2" --target cteas_p2_gen_fraction --parallel 2
          cmake -S native_cpp/p3 -B "$b/p3" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=g++-12
          cmake --build "$b/p3" --parallel 2
          ctest --test-dir "$b/p3" --output-on-failure
      - name: Generate actual native P1/P2/P3 and stage strict P6 input manifest
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          root="$RUNNER_TEMP/s2c"
          src=project/cases/hefei5km_2022_reference_case_20261011
          stage="$root/hefei5km_2022_reference_case_20261011"
          mkdir -p "$root/p123" "$stage/geo/makegeo" "$stage/met/upperair/final" "$stage/met/surface/final" "$stage/run/met"
          cp "$src/case.yaml" "$stage/case.yaml"
          cp "$src/geo/makegeo/makegeo.inp" "$stage/geo/makegeo/makegeo.inp"
          cp "$src/met/upperair/final/up_58424.dat" "$stage/met/upperair/final/up_58424.dat"
          cp "$src/met/upperair/final/stations.csv" "$stage/met/upperair/final/stations.csv"
          cp "$src/met/surface/final/surf.dat" "$stage/met/surface/final/surf.dat"
          cp "$src/met/surface/final/stations.csv" "$stage/met/surface/final/stations.csv"
          cp "$src/run/met/met.inp" "$stage/run/met/met.inp"
          test ! -e "$stage/run/met/met.dat"
          gen=calpuff_terrain_and_landuse_data_crop/hefei_5km/eurasia_asia_landuse/eausgs2_0la_hefei_5km.generic.txt
          "$root/build/p1/cteas_p1_terrain" "$root/source-srtm.tif" 510.8846439571007 3531.2689269678035 "$root/p123/p1.csv"
          "$root/build/p2/cteas_p2_gen_fraction" "$gen" 510.8846439571007 3531.2689269678035 "$root/p123/p2.csv"
          "$root/build/p3/cteas_p12_to_p3_dat" terrain "$root/p123/p1.csv" "$root/p123/terrel.dat"
          "$root/build/p3/cteas_p12_to_p3_dat" landuse "$root/p123/p2.csv" "$root/p123/lu.dat"
          "$root/build/p3/cteas_p3_makegeo" "$stage/geo/makegeo/makegeo.inp" "$root/p123/lu.dat" "$root/p123/terrel.dat" "$root/p123/p3.csv" "$stage/geo/makegeo/geo.dat"
          python3 - "$stage" "$root/p6-input-manifest.json" <<'PY'
          import hashlib,json,pathlib,sys
          from native_cpp.orchestration.handoff_gate import EXPECTED,PROFILE
          from native_cpp.orchestration.plan import CASE_ID
          root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); data={"schema_version":1,"case_name":CASE_ID,"science_profile":PROFILE,"source_head":"8a2d8edb9b764dade39167a73247f9e4ee278b4d","artifacts":{}}
          for role,(relative,producer) in EXPECTED["p6"].items():
              b=(root/relative).read_bytes()
              data["artifacts"][role]={"path":relative,"producer":producer,"bytes":len(b),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()}
          pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+"\n")
          print("S2C_REAL_NATIVE_P3_WRITER=EXECUTED")
          print("S2C_P4_P5_SCIENCE=PREVIOUSLY_VALIDATED_FROZEN_FILES_NOT_REGENERATED")
          PY
          python3 -m native_cpp.orchestration.handoff_gate --consumer p6 --root "$stage" --manifest "$root/p6-input-manifest.json" > "$root/audit/preflight.json"
          sha256sum "$stage/geo/makegeo/geo.dat" "$stage/met/upperair/final/up_58424.dat" "$stage/met/upperair/final/stations.csv" "$stage/met/surface/final/surf.dat" "$stage/met/surface/final/stations.csv" >> "$root/audit/original-input-sha256.txt"
      - name: Compile actual native P6D/P6E/P6F source kernels
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          b="$RUNNER_TEMP/s2c/build"
          cmake -S native_cpp/modules/p6_calmet -B "$b/p6d" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=g++-12
          cmake --build "$b/p6d" --parallel 2 --target cteas_p6_realcase_wind_field cteas_p6_native_cgamma_grid_143h cteas_p6_native_hourly_driver
          cmake -S native_cpp/modules/p6_calmet/p6e -B "$b/p6e" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=g++-12
          cmake --build "$b/p6e" --parallel 2 --target p6e_calmet_dat21 p6e_p6c_hourly_bridge
          cmake -S native_cpp/modules/p6_calmet/p6f -B "$b/p6f" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=g++-12 -DP6F_REPO_ROOT="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
          cmake --build "$b/p6f" --parallel 2 --target cteas_p6f_geo_static_provenance cteas_p6f_p6e_source_metadata
      - name: Real native P6 1h, 6h, then 143h with no original MET in staged case
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          root="$RUNNER_TEMP/s2c"
          case="$root/hefei5km_2022_reference_case_20261011"
          for hours in 1 6 143; do
            test ! -e "$case/run/met/met.dat"
            args=(--case-yaml "$case/case.yaml" --manifest "$root/p6-input-manifest.json"
                  --work "$root/work-$hours" --hours "$hours"
                  --driver "$root/build/p6d/cteas_p6_native_hourly_driver"
                  --p6d "$root/build/p6d/cteas_p6_realcase_wind_field"
                  --p6e "$root/build/p6e/p6e_calmet_dat21"
                  --bridge "$root/build/p6e/p6e_p6c_hourly_bridge"
                  --cgamma "$root/build/p6d/cteas_p6_native_cgamma_grid_143h"
                  --p6e-source-builder "$root/build/p6f/cteas_p6f_p6e_source_metadata")
            if test "$hours" -eq 143; then args+=(--p6f-writer "$root/build/p6f/cteas_p6f_geo_static_provenance"); fi
            echo "S2C_REAL_NATIVE_P6_START_HOURS=$hours"
            if ! python3 -m native_cpp.orchestration.run_p6 "${args[@]}" --execute > "$root/audit/run-$hours.json" 2>"$root/audit/run-$hours-stderr.txt"; then
              cat "$root/audit/run-$hours.json"
              for f in "$root/work-$hours"/*.log "$root/work-$hours"/hour_000/*.log; do
                if test -f "$f"; then echo "==== $f"; tail -n 80 "$f"; fi
              done
              exit 1
            fi
            grep -q '"status": "P6_EXECUTED_SCIENCE_NOT_ACCEPTED"' "$root/audit/run-$hours.json"
            test -s "$root/work-$hours/native_causal_calmet.dat"
            echo "S2C_REAL_NATIVE_P6_FINISHED_HOURS=$hours"
          done

      - name: Build pinned untouched original CALMET 6.5.0 (comparator only)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          root="$RUNNER_TEMP/s2c"
          git clone --filter=blob:none --sparse --no-checkout --depth=1 https://github.com/RRain001/CTEAS.git "$root/vendor-repo"
          git -C "$root/vendor-repo" fetch --depth=1 origin dfad99a78ed84d655e21411c9d25eb0d2583bf13
          git -C "$root/vendor-repo" checkout --detach dfad99a78ed84d655e21411c9d25eb0d2583bf13
          git -C "$root/vendor-repo" sparse-checkout set engine/vendor/src/CALMET_v6.5.0_L150223
          vendor="$root/vendor-repo/engine/vendor/src/CALMET_v6.5.0_L150223"
          test -s "$vendor/calmet.for"
          test "$(git -C "$root/vendor-repo" hash-object "$vendor/calmet.for")" = 437f43bb7f0e51a1919e56664663e1a046986ed0
          mkdir -p "$root/vendor-inc"
          for f in "$vendor"/*; do
            if test -f "$f"; then
              lname="$(basename "$f" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
              ln -s "$f" "$root/vendor-inc/$lname"
            fi
          done
          gfortran-11 -std=legacy -ffixed-line-length-none -fno-automatic -fno-align-commons -fallow-argument-mismatch -O0 -I"$root/vendor-inc" "$vendor/calmet.for" -o "$root/original-calmet.x"
          echo "PINNED_ORIGINAL_CALMET_BLOB=437f43bb7f0e51a1919e56664663e1a046986ed0" >> "$root/audit/source.txt"
      - name: Execute original CALMET independently with exactly the native fresh GEO and P4/P5
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          root="$RUNNER_TEMP/s2c"
          native="$root/hefei5km_2022_reference_case_20261011"
          original="$root/original-case/hefei5km_2022_reference_case_20261011"
          mkdir -p "$root/original-case"
          cp -a "$native" "$original"
          test ! -e "$original/run/met/met.dat"
          for file in geo/makegeo/geo.dat met/upperair/final/up_58424.dat met/surface/final/surf.dat run/met/met.inp; do
            cmp "$native/$file" "$original/$file"
          done
          echo "P6_NATIVE_AND_ORIGINAL_INPUT_BYTES=IDENTICAL" > "$root/audit/original-input-identity.txt"
          set +e
          (cd "$original/run/met" && "$root/original-calmet.x" met.inp) > "$root/audit/original-calmet-stdout.txt" 2>"$root/audit/original-calmet-stderr.txt"
          code=$?
          set -e
          if test "$code" -ne 0 || ! test -s "$original/run/met/met.dat"; then
            echo "ORIGINAL_CALMET_FAILED_EXIT=$code"
            tail -n 60 "$root/audit/original-calmet-stdout.txt"
            tail -n 60 "$root/audit/original-calmet-stderr.txt"
            if test -f "$original/run/met/met.lst"; then tail -n 60 "$original/run/met/met.lst"; fi
            exit 1
          fi
          sha256sum "$original/run/met/met.dat" "$root/work-143/native_causal_independent_header_calmet.dat" >> "$root/audit/original-input-sha256.txt"
          echo "ORIGINAL_CALMET_FRESH_GEO_143H_EXECUTED=TRUE"
      - name: Independent fresh original versus native same-GEO 143h unrelaxed 45-field gate
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          root="$RUNNER_TEMP/s2c"
          original="$root/original-case/hefei5km_2022_reference_case_20261011/run/met/met.dat"
          candidate="$root/work-143/native_causal_independent_header_calmet.dat"
          "$root/build/p6e/p6e_calmet_dat21" compare --reference "$original" --candidate "$candidate" --out "$root/audit/fresh-original-vs-native-143h-45field.json" > "$root/audit/fresh-original-vs-native-stdout.txt" 2>&1 || {
            echo "S2C_SAME_FRESH_INPUT_SCIENCE=FAIL"
            tail -n 60 "$root/audit/fresh-original-vs-native-stdout.txt"
            exit 1
          }
          python3 - "$root/audit/fresh-original-vs-native-143h-45field.json" <<'PY'
          import json,sys
          x=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
          assert x["intervals"]==143 and x["total_exceedances"]==0
          print("S2C_SAME_FRESH_GEO_ORIGINAL_NATIVE_143H=PASS_SCOPED")
          PY
      - name: Export only non-binary numerical reports and logs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: s2c-fresh-original-calmet-2022-metrics-only
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/s2c/audit/*.txt
            ${{ runner.temp }}/s2c/audit/*.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/s2c/work-1/s2c_execution_evidence.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/s2c/work-6/s2c_execution_evidence.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/s2c/work-143/s2c_execution_evidence.json

name: S2C canonical 3-decimal UTM origin true-input gate
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - automation/verify-s2c-three-decimal-origin-20261017
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/s2c-three-decimal-origin-20261017.yml
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  exact-head-origin-and-geo-parity:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Exact PR27 source commit
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: 87dbb3120facba33094e4a3fa756d4ac8194bc8d
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify source and install no-G5 requirements
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "87dbb3120facba33094e4a3fa756d4ac8194bc8d"
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/grid-precision/build" "$RUNNER_TEMP/grid-precision/audit"
          echo "PR27_CODE_SHA=87dbb3120facba33094e4a3fa756d4ac8194bc8d" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/grid-precision/audit/source-head.txt"
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends cmake g++-12 libgdal-dev
          python3 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check PyYAML==6.0.3
      - name: Python config writer quantizes actual UTM origins before use
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -m unittest engine.preprocess.grid.tests.test_grid_origin_precision -v
      - name: Build selected P1/P2/P3 executables
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          b="$RUNNER_TEMP/grid-precision/build"
          cmake -S native_cpp/p1 -B "$b/p1" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=g++-12
          cmake --build "$b/p1" --parallel 2
          cmake -S native_cpp -B "$b/p2" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=g++-12
          cmake --build "$b/p2" --parallel 2
          cmake -S native_cpp/p3 -B "$b/p3" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=g++-12
          cmake --build "$b/p3" --parallel 2
      - name: CTest P1/P2/P3 selected regression and forbidden coordinate checks
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          b="$RUNNER_TEMP/grid-precision/build"
          ctest --test-dir "$b/p1" --output-on-failure
          ctest --test-dir "$b/p2" --output-on-failure
          ctest --test-dir "$b/p3" --output-on-failure
      - name: Restore SRTM via pinned immutable source and hash-verify land use
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          root="$RUNNER_TEMP/grid-precision"
          curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 2 --output "$root/source-srtm.tif" \
            https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RRain001/CTEAS/dfad99a78ed84d655e21411c9d25eb0d2583bf13/calpuff_terrain_and_landuse_data_crop/hefei_5km/china_srtm/srtm_60_06_hefei_5km.tif
          echo "c4211914fce527d2ad41ecac1e668d7faa2904bbbfd9135868ee83ef0d32123f  $root/source-srtm.tif" | sha256sum -c -
          gen=calpuff_terrain_and_landuse_data_crop/hefei_5km/eurasia_asia_landuse/eausgs2_0la_hefei_5km.generic.txt
          echo "bd937d99fb13b49ac6185c080359bef050afe76fc63945ac53b7d676547d43dc  $gen" | sha256sum -c -
      - name: Explicit noncanonical and wrong-grid origin rejection at executable boundary
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          root="$RUNNER_TEMP/grid-precision"
          p1="$root/build/p1/cteas_p1_terrain"
          p2="$root/build/p2/cteas_p2_gen_fraction"
          gen=calpuff_terrain_and_landuse_data_crop/hefei_5km/eurasia_asia_landuse/eausgs2_0la_hefei_5km.generic.txt
          for bad_x in 510.8846439571007 510.8850 510.886; do
            if "$p1" "$root/source-srtm.tif" "$bad_x" 3531.269 "$root/should-not-exist-p1.csv" > "$root/audit/p1-bad.stdout" 2>"$root/audit/p1-bad.stderr"; then
              echo "UNEXPECTED_P1_ORIGIN_ACCEPTANCE=$bad_x"; exit 1
            fi
            grep -q "GRID_ORIGIN_" "$root/audit/p1-bad.stderr"
            test ! -e "$root/should-not-exist-p1.csv"
            if "$p2" "$gen" "$bad_x" 3531.269 "$root/should-not-exist-p2.csv" > "$root/audit/p2-bad.stdout" 2>"$root/audit/p2-bad.stderr"; then
              echo "UNEXPECTED_P2_ORIGIN_ACCEPTANCE=$bad_x"; exit 1
            fi
            grep -q "GRID_ORIGIN_" "$root/audit/p2-bad.stderr"
            test ! -e "$root/should-not-exist-p2.csv"
          done
          echo "EXACT_THREE_DECIMAL_P1_P2_INPUT_GATES=PASS"
      - name: Execute P1-P3 with historical canonical 3-decimal origin and verify all 20000 GEO values
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          root="$RUNNER_TEMP/grid-precision"
          b="$root/build"
          gen=calpuff_terrain_and_landuse_data_crop/hefei_5km/eurasia_asia_landuse/eausgs2_0la_hefei_5km.generic.txt
          frozen=project/cases/hefei5km_2022_reference_case_20261011
          "$b/p1/cteas_p1_terrain" "$root/source-srtm.tif" 510.885 3531.269 "$root/p1.csv"
          "$b/p2/cteas_p2_gen_fraction" "$gen" 510.885 3531.269 "$root/p2.csv"
          "$b/p3/cteas_p12_to_p3_dat" terrain "$root/p1.csv" "$root/terrel.dat"
          "$b/p3/cteas_p12_to_p3_dat" landuse "$root/p2.csv" "$root/lu.dat"
          "$b/p3/cteas_p3_makegeo" "$frozen/geo/makegeo/makegeo.inp" "$root/lu.dat" "$root/terrel.dat" "$root/p3.csv" "$root/geo.dat"
          python3 - "$root" "$frozen/geo/makegeo/geo.dat" <<'PY'
          import hashlib,json,sys
          from pathlib import Path
          from native_cpp.reference.compare_p3_makegeo import parse_geo,FIELD_SPECS
          root=Path(sys.argv[1]); old=Path(sys.argv[2]); candidate=root/"geo.dat"
          original=parse_geo(old);generated=parse_geo(candidate)
          counts={name:sum(a!=b for a,b in zip(original[name],generated[name])) for name,_,_ in FIELD_SPECS}
          report={"status":"PASS" if sum(counts.values())==0 else "FAIL",
                  "origin_x_km":510.885,"origin_y_km":3531.269,
                  "cells_per_field":2500,"fields":len(FIELD_SPECS),
                  "total_mismatches":sum(counts.values()),"field_mismatches":counts,
                  "historical_geo_sha256":hashlib.sha256(old.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                  "canonical_native_geo_sha256":hashlib.sha256(candidate.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                  "byte_identity_claim":False}
          (root/"audit/canonical-three-decimal-geo-20k.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+"\n")
          print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
          assert report["total_mismatches"]==0
          assert report["fields"]==8
          print("THREE_DECIMAL_ORIGIN_FROZEN_GEO_20000_VALUES=PASS")
          PY
      - name: Upload only metrics, not restricted SRTM original binaries
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: s2c-three-decimal-origin-exact-head-metrics
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/grid-precision/audit/*.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/grid-precision/audit/source-head.txt
